Checkmarx AST Results VS Code extension compromised

Target: checkmarx-ast-results-extension
Repository: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=checkmarx.ast-results
Date: 2026-03-23 to 2026-04-22 (30 days)
Attribution: Advanced Persistent Threat
Component: Plugin
Language: TypeScript
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: true
Impact Type: Credential theft
User Impact: 0
Domain: open-vsx.org (package host)
Artifact Type: extension
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

Malicious versions of the Checkmarx AST Results VS Code extension were published through third-party extension marketplaces during the Checkmarx supply-chain incident. Checkmarx reported an Open VSX malicious version 2.53.0 on March 23, 2026 and later malicious versions 2.63 and 2.66 on April 22, 2026 across Microsoft Marketplace and Open VSX windows.
